context: Introduce ResolvedCredential(token, source, capability) or equivalent and carry it through connect/HostedConnection/doctor without copying token values into output. Public callers' DatabaseConfig.auth_token remains highest precedence but has unknown external provenance and generic remediation; CLI doctor must not resolve env and then erase provenance by passing it as an explicit token. Use E_AUTH_MISSING and E_AUTH_REJECTED via TodoDBError.code, with additive doctor JSON code/source fields. Do not invent E_AUTH_CAPABILITY from an ambiguous 403: normal RW mode never selects RO env, while explicit-token capability is unknowable. Narrow classification to 401 or explicit unauthorized/forbidden/invalid-token/JWT-expired evidence; do not classify bare 403, authority, auth*, or token* text alone. Build sanitized fixtures including the observed Turso 400 JWT InvalidToken, expiry, network/TLS/proxy authority text, quota/suspension, and attempted RO-write behavior; if upstream evidence cannot distinguish a case, keep exit 2 and document best effort. Land only after wrapper-token-hygiene.
description: After v2 wrappers no longer auto-mint, make runtime and doctor use one provenance-aware hosted credential resolver. RW requires TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN. RO prefers TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN and falls back to TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN only when RO is absent/empty; a present rejected RO token must never trigger RW retry. Missing credentials and confidently classified server rejection become HostedAuthError exit 4 with stable .code values; network, quota/suspension, protocol and ambiguous 403 failures remain generic exit 2. Preserve exact redaction and expose only source variable/capability metadata. Narrow today's broad auth/token regex using a reviewed fixture corpus and describe classification as best-effort where upstream errors are ambiguous.

anti_patterns.dont: Classify any message containing auth*, token*, or bare 403 as authentication
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD require high-confidence status/phrases and keep ambiguous failures exit 2
anti_patterns.why: authority/network and quota/suspension errors would receive destructive credential remediation

anti_patterns.dont: Retry rejected RO credentials with RW
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD fail exit 4 and require explicit operator correction
anti_patterns.why: it hides bad permissions or accidental writes and silently escalates capability

item_meta.blocked_reason: Release gate: do not ship missing-token exit 4 until wrapper-token-hygiene has removed implicit minting and provided a safe stale-wrapper migration; then explicitly unblock after reviewing that migration evidence.

preserves.behavior: A present TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN is never replaced by RW after rejection; fallback occurs only when RO is absent or empty.
Hosted URL and every token value remain absent from exceptions, tracebacks, doctor output, JSON, logs, and tests.
HostedAuthError remains a TodoDBError subclass; existing library callers catching TodoDBError continue to work.

verifications.command: uv run pytest tests/test_hosted_backend.py -q -k 'auth or outage or network or quota or authority'
